subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should the explicit `logging.consoleStyle: "json"` contract normalize the repaired diagnostic paths into JSON envelopes even for operators that previously consumed those incidental lines as plain text?
rationale: The branch fixes the documented structured-logging behavior, but the user-visible output change is intentional and can affect existing operator parsers; that compatibility tradeoff requires maintainer intent rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Accept the JSONL contract
options.body: Approve the documented JSON console behavior after a base refresh, preserving raw `--json` command results while making repaired diagnostics structured.

options.title: Narrow the changed diagnostic surface
options.body: Retain only the original three reported bypass fixes if maintainers want to minimize behavioral change beyond the reported ingestion regression.

recommendation.title: Accept the JSONL contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented JSON console behavior after a base refresh, preserving raw `--json` command results while making repaired diagnostics structured.
